🎲 Welcome to Roll For Avatar Items!

How to Play:
🎁 Roll for rare and valuable avatar items!
💵 Place and upgrade your items to earn more cash!
🍀 Upgrade your base to increase your luck and income!
🏆 Collect the rarest items and complete your collection!
👑 Build your fortune and become the richest player of them all!

🔑 Codes:
RELEASE
200Likes
500Likes
1KLikes

👍 New OP code at 5,000 Likes!

📱 Play on Mobile, Tablet, PC, and Console!

⚠️ All items and currency earned are available only in-game and cannot be used or transferred outside of this experience.
